_doc: Blind 2016-tier BBB hospital muni obligor universe. Identified using contemporary sources dated 2016-2017 (primarily Business Wire press release feeds reproducing Fitch/Moody's/S&P rating actions, plus Becker's Hospital Review search-snippet excerpts). NO 2024-2025 information was consulted to select or exclude these names.
_methodology_warning: All names below were identified from rating-action press releases dated calendar year 2016 (with two boundary cases — Halifax Health March 2016 and Memorial Hospital at Gulfport which was Baa1 in 2016 and subsequently downgraded to Baa2 in 2017). The 2016-tier rating cited is the one disclosed in the contemporaneous press release, not any later action.

Becker's Hospital Review URLs returned HTTP 403 during research, so most Becker's-based confirmations come from Google search snippet text rather than full-article retrieval. Business Wire press-release titles were used as primary evidence where available (title itself encodes the rating).
Annual revenue figures are 'approximate' — taken from the press release narrative when available, otherwise rounded from the press release's fiscal-year operating-revenue figure.

CONTAMINATION DISCLOSURE: While searching, two search snippets surfaced 2017+ events that I did NOT use for selection but did read: (a) MaineGeneral was downgraded from BBB- to BB in May 2017, so I excluded MaineGeneral (would have unfairly preferred a name that later turned distressed); (b) Halifax Health was upgraded from BBB+ to A- in Oct 2017, and Hurley was upgraded from BB+ to BBB- in Dec 2015 (so BBB- as of 2016-12-31 is correct). I did not look up 2024-2025 status for any obligor on this list.
in_current_universe flags reflect string-match against the user-provided 2025 universe list; I did NOT preferentially include or exclude based on this — the 2016 evidence stands on its own.
